plan.title: The Last Survivor
plan.logline: A lighthouse keeper receives a message from a ship lost at sea and chooses to rescue its last survivor.
plan.ending: The lighthouse keeper, a seasoned survivor, finds the last survivor of the ship, a young girl, and decides to save her.
